eggs.name: Common Egg
eggs.description: A plain white shell with soft grey shading. A familiar farm or woodland animal waits inside.
sources: Steal a wild egg in an enabled spawn channel at Beginner rank or higher.
Use /start to receive three Common eggs when you first join the game in a server.
Claim an egg-bearing daily objective in /quest.

eggs.description: A deep red shell surrounds a ruby, with fiery markings across its surface.
sources: Steal a wild egg in an enabled spawn channel at Mythic Master rank or higher.

eggs.name: Celestial Egg
eggs.description: A tiny starfield crosses the navy shell, encircled by a luminous orbit.
sources: Steal a wild egg in an enabled spawn channel at Celestial Warden rank or higher.

eggs.name: Divine Egg
eggs.description: Golden wings and a halo frame this ivory egg.
sources: Steal a wild egg in an enabled spawn channel at Divine Sovereign rank or higher.

eggs.name: Eternal Egg
eggs.description: Prismatic cracks and an orbit of light break across an obsidian shell.
sources: Steal a wild egg in an enabled spawn channel at Eternal Ascendant rank or higher.
